budget_items.topic: Free cash applied in the preliminary budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager reported free cash going to capital items, to OPEB, and to the Stabilization Account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Health insurance was reduced to a maximum increase of 3.7%, or a $116,183 increase, with the actual renewal due by end of February.
budget_items.quote: currently reduced to max. of 3.7% increase or $116,183 increase.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The preliminary recommendation was a 2.5% increase; the Superintendent's proposed budget fell from 4% to 3.64%, which is $219K more than target budget.
budget_items.quote: decreased from a 4% to a 3.64% increase or $219k more than target budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Capital items in the preliminary budget totaled the amount printed, with details in the linked presentation and budget documents.
budget_items.quote: capital: $1,329,133 - details outlined in linked presentation

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Unallocated funds in the preliminary budget were printed at the amount shown; the Town Manager later listed items still to be resolved against them.
The tax rate is projected to increase by the amount printed per $1,000 of valuation.
DPW changes included added pavement management, facilities and cemetery funds, elimination of an assistant mechanic position, and a reduction in electricity costs.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Fire budget funds the target budget and a printed amount of the above-target request.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A resident estimated excise tax revenue was conservatively projected by about the amount printed; the finance director explained the conservative estimate.
